sources.description: Official FIFA Data Platform match feed for FIFA World Cup 2026, season 285023; authoritative for teams, group slots, fixtures, UTC kickoffs, match status, results, shootouts, and winners at the cutoff.
Official FIFA World Cup 2026 team list.
Official FIFA final draw and group allocation page.

Official FIFA match schedule document, dated 5 September 2025; authoritative for match numbering and knockout winner/loser formulas, reconciled with the current FIFA match feed for resolved participants and kickoff times.

interpretations: Existing product country IDs and display names are preserved; official FIFA names are retained as import aliases.
Round-of-32 group-position and best-third formulas remain descriptive official slots and are not converted into unsupported database match-source slots.
From the Round of 16 onward, Wnn denotes the winner of match nn and RUnn denotes the losing team of match nn.
The live FIFA match feed supersedes the pre-draw schedule document for resolved teams, results, match status, and kickoff timestamps.
sourceDiscrepancies: No contradictory finalized tournament fact was found. The schedule document retains pre-resolution slot labels while the live FIFA feed names resolved countries; the live feed is used for those current resolved participants as documented above.
